title: Counter value after repeated decrements
statement: For natural numbers $R$ and $i$ with $i \le R$, applying the fixed-width decrement $i$ times to the binary digit word of $R$ produces a word with value $R-i$.
replaced:
For all natural numbers $R$ and $i$ with $i \le R$, applying the fixed-width little-
endian decrement $i$ times to the binary digit word of $R$ yields a word of counter
value exactly $R - i$.
